categories.main_business_segments: Naipu Mining Machinery Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of heavy mining beneficiation equipment and new material wear-resistant spare parts. Its main product lines include slurry pumps, hydrocyclones, grinding mill liners, rubber wear-resistant parts, metal wear parts, mining pipelines, and beneficiation system solutions. The company also provides beneficiation process design, consulting, and optimization services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on the research and development of high-performance polymer composite rubber materials and rubber composite materials to enhance the performance, reliability, and lifespan of heavy mining beneficiation equipment. It employs advanced manufacturing techniques for large-scale slurry pumps and hydrocyclones, and has proprietary technology in polymer composite wear-resistant materials that outperform traditional metal parts in wear resistance, corrosion resistance, and environmental friendliness. Production includes both in-house manufacturing and outsourced processing for non-critical components, with strict quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Naipu serves large-scale modern non-ferrous and ferrous metal mining enterprises and major mining machinery manufacturers. Key customers include well-known domestic and international mining companies such as Erdenet Mining Corporation, CITIC Heavy Industries, Zijin Mining, Jiangxi Copper Group, and Oyu Tolgoi LLC. The company’s products are widely used in beneficiation processes for copper, iron, and other metal ores.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters in Jiangxi Province and has established subsidiaries and production bases in Mongolia, Australia, Peru, Chile, Zambia, Singapore, Serbia, Ecuador, Mexico, and other countries. It targets resource-rich regions in Central Asia, South America, Africa, and Oceania, with overseas sales accounting for over 60% of revenue. The company is actively expanding its global footprint through overseas factories and sales offices.
categories.supply_chain_position: Naipu operates primarily in the midstream segment of the mining equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of beneficiation equipment and wear-resistant spare parts. It also provides system integration and beneficiation process consulting services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider within the mining equipment industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance polymer composite materials and large-scale, high-end beneficiation equipment. R&D efforts focus on developing new rubber formulations, forged composite liners, ceramic slurry pump components, and energy-efficient equipment designs. It aims to break international monopolies in large slurry pump markets and enhance product lifespan and efficiency. The company also invests in digitalization and intelligent manufacturing to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of mining equipment, wear-resistant spare parts, mining pipelines, and beneficiation system solutions. The company also earns income from engineering procurement and construction (EPC) contracts for beneficiation plants and provides after-sales services. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales channels, including bidding and long-term contracts with major mining enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Naipu competes with international mining equipment giants such as Metso, Weir Group, and AIA, which have advanced technology and comprehensive product lines. Domestically, it faces competition from foreign-funded enterprises, state-owned enterprises, and private companies. Naipu differentiates itself through its product range, large-scale equipment capabilities, polymer composite material technology, and strong international market presence, holding a leading position in China’s beneficiation equipment sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Naipu achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, representing a 19.62% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 116.47 million, up 45.46% from the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 2.57 billion with net assets of RMB 1.58 billion. The company has shown steady growth with expanding international sales and ongoing investments in production capacity and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Naipu emphasizes its advanced polymer composite wear-resistant materials that offer superior wear resistance, corrosion resistance, lighter weight, and environmental benefits compared to traditional metal parts. Its large-scale slurry pumps and hydrocyclones meet international standards and fill domestic market gaps. The company provides customized solutions tailored to client needs, comprehensive after-sales service, and integrated beneficiation system design, delivering enhanced operational efficiency and cost savings to mining customers.
